items.descriptionEn: A traditional Cretan salad featuring barley rusks topped with ripe tomatoes, creamy cheese, olive rings, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
A delightful blend of baked cheeses, tomatoes, and green peppers, seasoned with oregano and chili flakes.
Golden and crispy hand-cut fries, perfectly seasoned with sea salt.
A refreshing Greek dip made with creamy yogurt, cucumber, and garlic.
A vibrant mix of tomatoes, cucumbers, green peppers, onions, olives, and feta cheese, all dressed in olive oil and oregano.
Tender, thinly sliced meat seasoned with traditional spices, served with a side of French fries and tzatziki.
Grilled chicken fillet seasoned with herbs and spices, served with a side of French fries and tzatziki.
Juicy, marinated chicken slices, served with a side of French fries and tzatziki.
A trio of grilled meatballs made with ground beef. Served with a side of French fries and tzatziki.
Chunks of pork and chicken grilled on a skewer, served with a side of French fries and tzatziki.
Crispy golden rings of squid, served with a side of French fries and pickle mayo sauce.
Italian-style pizza with tomato sauce, mozzarella, basil leaves, and a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.
